statement: Today nothing about a message's meaning is computed when it arrives. Only its row and its keyword index entry are written.
Every gate attempt parses the 19.9 MB voice index pairs.json twice.
The SubQ request is under a third of the voice reading's time. Most gate time is local work and Jina calls.
The gate sends SubQ matt's replies from conversations on every platform, not only this chat.
The writing guide the gate sends was written from matt's X posts, and is sent whole for every chat on every platform.
log.db keeps no per-conversation record of what is open, what was asked, or what matt already said.
In the Invoker case, drafts written as a list of questions scored voice 0.15 to 0.22 against a pass of 0.8.
Each account's one owner already appends every incoming message to log.db in one transaction, so it is the place a per-message background step would run.
